title: Bringing 'The Last Blossom' to Life: 'ODD TAXI' Team Returns with 'Housenka'
content: Following their acclaimed work ODD TAXI , director Baku Kinoshita and writer Kazuya Konomoto return with Housenka ( The Last Blossom ), an original movie from animation studio CLAP and produced by Pony Canyon .

title: 10 Best Anime to Watch on Netflix in September 2026
content: September 2026 is right around the corner as Netflix keeps expanding its library with all kinds of exciting new anime. Unlike Crunchyroll, which releases seasonal anime every quarter, Netflix has something new to offer fans every month.
author: ComicBook

title: 1 Year Later, Jujutsu Kaisen’s Most Emotional Arc Is Getting a New U.S. Release
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 still has a long way to go, but the anime keeps returning with all kinds of updates for fans. Written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, the manga began serialization in 2018 before receiving an anime adaptation by MAPPA in 2020.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Confirms a New U.S. Release For The Apothecary Diaries Before Season 3
content: The Apothecary Diaries is all set to make its comeback in October this year as part of the Fall 2026 lineup. Based on the critically acclaimed light novel by Hyūganatsu, the story centers around Maomao, a genius apothecary with a knack for solving mysteries. The anime debuted in 2023 and ran for two cours until 2024.
author: ComicBook

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Breaks Silence on Manga Finale
content: The Weekly Shonen Jump magazine by Shueisha is easily the most successful manga publication of all time. The magazine was launched in 1968 and rose through the ranks after serializing classics such as Dragon Ball, Naruto , and more.

title: Crunchyroll App Shutting Down for Millions This October
content: The Crunchyroll app is shutting down for millions of users. The shutdown is set to happen on October 30, and it doesn’t matter if affected users download the app before then. Starting on this date, the app will simply no longer work.
author: ComicBook

title: 59 Years Later, Anime Still Can’t Top This Legendary Masterpiece
content: Anime and manga series have been coming out for almost a century now, and with modern technology, newer anime and manga are appearing much more attractive. However, what they can’t beat is a compelling and timeless narrative.

title: The Margrave's Daughter & the Enemy Prince Manga Ends, Gets Side Story
content: Cygames ' Cycomi platform published the final chapter of An Ogura 's The Margrave's Daughter and the Enemy Prince manga on July 11. Ogura also announced a side story for the series focused on the character Iris.
